paite: Pathian aw, pau lou in om ke'nla; Pathian aw, dai nilouh ke'n, om maimai mahmah ke'n.
heading: Asaph phatna La; La khat. / Israelte Melmate Zohna Dia Thumna

paite: Ngai in, na melmate alum lutlut ua; nangmah hote adak hekhawk uhi.
Na mite lepchiahtak in asawm ua, na mi selgukte tung ah aselam in akihou akihoukhawm uhi.
Kisa dih ua, anam uh mangsak khop in i hihmang ding uh; Israel min himhim theihgige a a-om nawnlouhna ding in, achi uhi.
Thukhat sat in akihou ua; na tung ah aselam a hih ding in thu achiamkhawm uhi.
Edom leh Ishmael puaninte, Moab leh Haggar;
Gebal leh Ammon leh Amalek; Philistiate Tura a omte toh,
Assuriate amau lam ah apang ua; Lot suante apanpih uhi. Selah
Amau Midiante tung a na hih bang, Kishon lui a Sisera tung a na hih bang, Jabin tung a na hih bang in hih sam in.
Huai mite Endor ah amang ua; lei a ding in eklei bang lel ana hita uhi.
Amiliante uh Oreb leh Zeeb bang in bawl inla, Ahi, a kumpipa tengteng uh Zebah leh Zalmunna bang in bawl in.
Huai mite'n, Pathian omnate i luahsak ding uh, achi uhi.
Ka Pathian aw, amaute leivui kipei lunglung bang in bawl in; buhsi huih mutleng bang in.
Gam kang mei bang leh, tang kang meikuang bang in.
Amau na huihpi in delh inla, na huih thupitak in hihlau in.
TOUPA aw, na min a zontheihna ding un amel uh zumna in hihdim in.
Tangtawn in zahlak leh mangbangtak in om uhenla; ahi, hihzum a om in mangthang uhen.
Nangmah kia Jehovah min pu, leitung tengteng tung a Tungnungpen na hi chih atheihna ding un.
